notes: Structured query templates for the TikTok Ads audit, built against the live TikTok Ads (ttads) schema and validated clean against a live account. Field IDs are raw. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date. compare_to_previous:true queries run twice (current + matching previous window). TikTok is MORE PERMISSIVE than LinkedIn/Reddit — audience dimensions (age, gender, country, platform, placement, interest_category) CAN combine with each other and with campaign dimensions (validated). We still keep demographics/placement/device/geo as separate single-purpose queries for cleaner analysis and to avoid row fragmentation. ROAS / CONVERSION VARIES BY ACCOUNT SETUP: TikTok exposes many conversion + ROAS sources depending on the campaign's optimization and tracking. Primary ROAS fields by setup: complete_payment_roas (web pixel purchases), onsite_shopping_roas (TikTok Shop / onsite), offline_shopping_events_roas (offline), gmv_roi (GMV Max campaigns). The generic outcome is conversion/cost_per_conversion/conversion_rate, and 'result'/cost_per_result is the optimization-goal outcome. Detect which is populated at runtime (see Step 5 in SKILL.md). Spend is real currency, NOT micros.

queries.title: Campaign Performance
queries.note: Swap complete_payment_roas for onsite_shopping_roas / offline_shopping_events_roas / gmv_roi if that is the account's tracked ROAS source (Step 5).

queries.title: Ad / Creative Performance
queries.note: compare_to_previous enables creative fatigue (CTR decline vs prior period). video_watched_6s / video_views_p100 power the 6s view-through and completion-rate checks. ad_format gives In-Feed / Spark / etc.

queries.title: Audience - Age & Gender
queries.note: age + gender validated together. interest_category is also available as its own query if interest-level analysis is needed.

queries.title: Geo Performance
queries.note: Use province_name instead of country for sub-national/region detail.
